# Kristofer Barrett om AI-oron och den skakiga börsen

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Börslunch on 23 October 2026, with guest Kristofer Barrett, a global/tech portfolio manager at Carmignac, focused on the recent 'AI jitters'. AI stocks peaked in early summer and Nasdaq peaked two weeks earlier. Software and other stocks seen as AI losers are rebounding, while AI hardware stocks have been sold off over debt-funded data-centre buildouts and lower growth expectations at Anthropic and OpenAI. Barrett is long equities but holds Nasdaq put options as protection and has trimmed tech. He avoids heavily indebted companies such as CoreWeave and prefers free-cash-flow businesses: TSMC, Nvidia, Tradeweb, S&P Global, payment companies and Cencora. He calls memory chips, especially SK Square as a discounted way into SK Hynix, his most controversial idea with the most relative upside. China's demographic problems and competition in electric cars weigh on Volvo Cars and Kering, while Volvo trucks gave a strong report.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 402340.KS — SK Square | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Owns about 20% of SK Hynix at a 40-50% discount and is down 67% from its peak. The guest sees the most relative upside in the AI space.

#### Reasoning

Guest view (Barrett). The memory market is an oligopoly. The market prices memory earnings as having peaked, but if hyperscalers honour their contracts, SK Hynix could earn its full market value within about three years. Through SK Square the discount means the whole value could in theory be earned in two years. Korean corporate governance has improved and buybacks are possible.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscalers cut or cancel memory contracts
- if AI investment slows materially
- if Chinese memory makers (CXMT) compete prices down
- if Korean governance concerns re-emerge

> *"Så inom AI-pusslet så är det här det mest kontroversiella, men också det som jag tror har mest relativ uppsida så länge det fortsätter investeras i AI."*

---

### 🟢 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Memory holding down from about 3 to 1.2. The guest believes it will keep earning despite market fears of a cycle peak.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. The memory oligopoly benefits from HBM demand driven by AI. The market is overly negative and fears earnings will collapse after the current contracts. The guest disagrees but admits the market is cyclical, so a low P/E is not the whole answer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices fall sharply
- if hyperscaler capex stops
- if Chinese competition gains share

> *"Jag vet att det är en cyklisk marknad, så vi ska inte sitta och titta på ett P3 och tro att det är liksom svaret på allting, men de lär tjäna pengar framöver."*

---

### 🟡 TSM — TSMC | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

A top holding and quality AI company with scale and technology advantages. The fund has trimmed tech overall.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. TSMC is a quality AI company that wins as long as the buildout continues, thanks to its scale and technical moat. The guest has trimmed tech exposure recently, so this is held rather than added to.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI buildout stops
- if the competitive moat erodes

> *"De har ju konkurrensfördelar som är både skala och tekniska fördelar som gör att de är... i långsiktiga vinnare med all säkerhet."*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

A top holding and quality AI company, seen as a long-term winner. The fund has reduced tech recently.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Like TSMC, a long-term winner of the AI buildout through scale and technology advantages. Hyperscalers and others keep investing at full speed, but the fund has trimmed tech overall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex slows
- if the AI buildout halts

> *"Det är liksom kvalitets-AI-bolagen. De är nog vinnare så länge det byggs ut någonting på sikt."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

The guest generally avoids highly indebted companies like CoreWeave despite its strong order book, and held it only very briefly.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. High debt makes companies fall with the market and not bounce back. Interest-rate and credit worries dominate. It is unclear how differentiated neoclouds are, and they depend on Nvidia's support and open credit markets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if debt is reduced materially
- if free cash flow turns positive

> *"Vi har ägt CoreWive under en ytterst kort period i vår techfond, men generellt undviker vi bolag som har hög skuldsättning, även om orderstocken och sånt där är väldigt fin."*

---

### 🟢 TW — Tradeweb | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Holding. Electronic bond-trading venue with structural growth, network effects and regulatory protection.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Bond trading is driven by volatility, and a large part of it is still not electronic, which gives structural growth. Low costs, network effects that AI cannot easily disrupt, and tight regulation. Fits the guest's free-cash-flow and low-debt approach.

#### Sell Triggers

- if trading volumes fall
- if AI or a competitor disrupts its network effects

> *"Sen är det här bara en rätt fin affär. Kostnaderna är inte så höga och du har ju de här nätverkseffekterna, något som inte AI tror jag kan rå på någon gång."*

---

### 🟡 SPGI — S&P Global | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

A holding the guest calls more controversial. It had a tough year as an AI loser and is now rebounding. AI is seen as complementary.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Its proprietary data is infrastructure-like, but its software products are at risk of being displaced by AI. As AI adoption proves slower than hoped, the stock is bouncing back. The data could be used together with AI and might even make it a winner.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI replaces its software or data products

> *"Det är inte så att man kommer kunna byta ut det helt, utan det blir komplementärt och skulle kunna till och med vara vinnare"*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell sharply on its report. The CFO sees no turnaround in China, and Chinese EV makers are outcompeting it.

#### Reasoning

Host and company commentary. A severe slump in China, US-related one-off costs, and the CFO is not counting on a turnaround. The guest notes Chinese competition in EVs hits Europe's car industry. The signal is inferred from negative commentary, not an explicit sell call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China demand turns around
- if margins recover

> *"Vi ser inte riktigt en vändning och det är inte det vi räknar med heller."*

---

### 🟡 HPOL-B — Hexpol | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A Carmignac holding, named as an industrial company benefiting from the AI and data-centre buildout.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Hexpol is one of the fund's few Swedish holdings. It is grouped with cable makers as a winner from the electricity and data-centre buildout around AI.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the data-centre buildout slows

> *"Vi har Hexpol till exempel som jag vet rapporterar idag."*
